name: jakos-ai-toolkit
description: Reusable agents and skills that travel between projects, taken from real work and detached from the repository where they were born.

plugins.name: cazabugs
plugins.description: A chain of four agents for bugs: one records and prioritizes them by how blocking they are, another reproduces them and finds the root cause, another fixes them, and a fourth tries to knock the fix down through a different path before closing. Also carries the round trip with GitHub issues.

plugins.name: forja
plugins.description: A chain of four agents for building features: one turns the request into testable criteria and slices, another finds out what already exists before inventing, another builds slice by slice, and a fourth reviews against the original criteria and hunts for what broke next door. The architect only runs when the feature introduces a new concept.

plugins.name: qa-squad
plugins.description: A testing squad that hunts bugs the way a QA does: a planner that finds what states the rules in this project and writes charters against them, testers that apply named techniques one at a time, and a triage that separates a defect from a deliberate decision. It registers findings and dispatches them; it fixes nothing.

plugins.name: scout-team
plugins.description: Scouts that use a module the way a person does — eyes and hands only, with no access to the page structure or the source, so that not finding something is itself the finding — and a lead that goes and measures why it was missable. It suggests improvements with the exact wording to use; it builds nothing.
